svg.title: MarketPulse architecture
svg.desc: MarketPulse architecture on Microsoft Fabric: Coinbase WebSocket and a market-data REST API feed Eventstream and Data Factory pipelines; Eventhouse (KQL, real-time) and a Lakehouse (Bronze, Silver, Gold Delta tables with PySpark) feed a star schema with indicators, a backtester and Direct Lake Power BI. Alongside: Great Expectations, Data Activator alerts, Git and deployment pipelines.
